scenes.vo: Last night, a stranger whispered, don't look. Then the lights went out, and he was gone.
The next night, I came in early. I needed to see him again, on tape. I needed PROOF.
I rewound camera one to three A.M. There I was, behind the counter. Alone.
But I remembered him clearly. He stood by the freezer for ten whole minutes, staring at me.
On the tape, the freezer aisle was EMPTY. The door chime never rang. Nobody walked in. Nobody walked out.
I watched every second, twice. Every second, something tall stood behind me. The man was never there. Only IT was.
